info.name: Nory - Video-Based Auto Marketplace API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for Nory Video-Based Auto Marketplace backend.
Includes automated token propagation, AI video lifecycle, audio selection, manual/AI reel posting, draft publishing, newsfeed, interactions, and messaging.

request.description: Fetches audio tracks uploaded by admin. Dealers choose a track to add background audio to their reels.

Car photo 4 (other side / front angle - reference element)

formdata.value: driving smoothly along a coastal highway at sunset
formdata.description: Optional scene direction (e.g., coastal highway at sunset, mountain road)

request.description: Uploads 1-7 car reference photos to generate a cinematic AI video. Dealer must be verified and have an active subscription.
Poll this endpoint until status becomes 'completed'. Once completed, use {{job_id}} to create the vehicle reel.
Simulates the callback from the car-video-agent service to Django's webhook endpoint. Query parameter ?token={{ai_video_webhook_token}} must match your AI_VIDEO_WEBHOOK_TOKEN in .env.

item.name: 4. List Dealer AI Videos (All or Unused)

request.description:
Lists all AI generated videos for the dealer. Filter options:
- ?unused=true (only completed videos not yet converted into reels - ideal for picking an AI video to publish)
- ?status=completed|pending|failed

Auto-saves the first result's job_id into {{job_id}}.

query.description: Filter: true for videos not yet used in a reel
